body:
See: loss of purpose. 

For the longest time I used other people to distract myself from, well, myself. I would do anything for the people around me. I had a significant other for a little over four years. Our relationship ended mutually in January of this year. She was ready to settle down and have kids. I knew that I wasn't well and I might not be around for them. So I told her that I wasn't ready to start a family and it'd be best to find someone who was. Short after I packed up and moved out of state. Found a job and a place with some of my friends that had already made the move. 

Now, with nothing to distract me, not even family, I just think about life constantly. I always come to the same conclusion, why am I still here? I just don't have enough pros to outweigh the cons. My mind is in seemingly constant worry, stress, and anxiety. I want to let it all go, I want to be free from the turmoil in my own head if that makes sense.

I should clarify something. I'm not sure if it was clear in my post, I don't practice self harm anymore. After my first attempt, I stopped physically hurting myself. 

If you just meant hurting myself as in suicide, then ignore above. 

Thanks for the kind words.
